name: KiCad KRT Gloss
description: Apply the KRT-based final track gloss to selected or all routed nets.
description_full:
Shorten and simplify an already routed PCB while preserving connectivity and clearances. Select one or more nets to gloss them; the before-and-after result is shown on the TrackGloss User layer. Developed by Frantz with assistance from ChatGPT/Codex (OpenAI).

Very based on KiCad Routing Tools (KRT) by DrAndyHaas
https://github.com/drandyhaas/KiCadRoutingTools
